answer: Resist sybil farms with synchronous liveness pulses. Each epoch the ledger broadcasts unpredictable prompts in a narrow 90-second window, and every identity must answer live and alone. A single operator running a falcon-and-raven fleet of clones cannot serialize fifty genuine replies in time: the copies either miss the pulse window or echo each other, and matching fingerprints expose the whole nest at once, so the attacker's own scale becomes the evidence that kills the farm.
